levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Fewer than two real items under one or more sections, or items appear invented rather than genuine.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: At least two genuine items appear under each of the four sections.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and items span a genuinely varied range of the learner's actual life rather than repeating one activity across sections.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: One or both rewritten bullet points do not open with an action verb, or the verb-choice explanation is missing or generic.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Both bullet points open with a specific action verb and each includes a real reason for that verb choice.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the chosen verbs are precise enough that a stranger could picture the specific action performed.

lookFors: No last name, address, or phone number appears anywhere on the document.
The hardest-section response names one specific section, not a restatement of the whole template being hard.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
